hero.availabilityBadge: Senior Software Engineer at KPMG, Malta
hero.headline: Designing and building scalable enterprise platforms that turn complex data into intelligent business decisions.
hero.paragraph1: I'm Prasanna Raja — 16+ years of engineering experience spanning enterprise application development, system architecture, and cloud and data platforms. My work turns complex operational and geospatial data into systems that support real business decisions, and increasingly extends into applied machine learning and modern AI engineering.
hero.paragraph2: I contributed to KPMG Dash, an award-winning analytics platform used by customers across the UK, spanning the .NET backend, React frontend, and Cube.js analytics layer. I also build geospatial and analytics solutions that combine customer, market, and spatial data into interactive maps and dashboards. I'm expanding my work into Agentic AI and Azure AI Foundry, building intelligent enterprise applications at the intersection of software engineering, analytics, and AI.

about.heading: About
about.paragraph1: I'm a senior software engineer with a strong background in enterprise application development, system architecture, and scalable backend platforms — built primarily on .NET and cloud infrastructure, with React and TypeScript on the front end.
about.paragraph2: Over the past few years, that foundation has extended into data and analytics platforms, including geospatial systems that combine large external datasets with customer and market data to support business decisions. That work is what led me into applied machine learning — and, more recently, into modern AI engineering: LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), the Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool calling, agentic workflows, and local LLM infrastructure, largely through Azure AI Foundry.
about.paragraph3: I see AI as the next layer of enterprise architecture, not a departure from it — my focus is on building production-oriented, AI-enabled applications on top of the same engineering discipline that scalable enterprise systems require.

bullets: Context — KPMG builds and operates enterprise-grade products used internally and by external clients, including analytics platforms that turn large external and operational datasets into business decisions.
Responsibility — design and development of product architecture across KART and KPMG Dash, from backend API design through to the analytics and UI layers.
Engineering — microservices built with .NET Core and Angular, integrated with an analytics layer to transform large-scale data into actionable, decision-ready views.
Impact — driving product innovation across two flagship KPMG products, combining product engineering with data-rich decision support for enterprise clients.
Developed a multi-national, multi-lingual educational platform using React, .NET Core, and Redis.
Engineered robust API interfaces for seamless application integration and high performance.
Designed and developed the UI for the Capital Cost Estimation Tool at Shell India.
Led front-end UI/UX implementation for an international team, building the interface from scratch.
Developed a health insurance application HAAD for the Abu Dhabi Government
An Insurance portal, which facilitates the management and processing of health insurance purchase, claims, and related workflows for the Abu Dhabi Government using EDirham payment integration.
Developed core application modules and integrated Qlik Sense dashboards into enterprise web applications.
Integrated the Qlik Sense Mashup API with AngularJS to embed interactive visualizations, including charts, tables, filters, and containers.
Designed, developed, and published dashboards, created ad-hoc reports, and established data connections for complex source systems.
Used NPrinting to generate Excel, configuring server tasks and scheduled jobs for automated delivery.
Gathered requirements, designed, and maintained applications spanning banking, oil-domain reporting, telecom production systems, and customer support workflows.
Managed software packaging, deployments, and support for critical enterprise systems.

projects.heading: Projects
projects.sectionIntro: A closer look at how the work gets built — starting with the platform that best reflects how I think about architecture, data, and product engineering together.

kpmgDash.title: KPMG Dash
kpmgDash.subtitle: Location & consumer analytics platform
kpmgDash.problemText: Consumer-facing businesses need to decide where to open, expand, or reposition — decisions that depend on combining a client's own data with a huge range of external market signals.
kpmgDash.platformText: Dash is a KPMG-built and run SaaS platform that blends a client's own data with 6B+ external data points to drive location, product, and cost decisions for consumer-facing businesses. It uses machine learning to predict prospective site revenue with 85%+ accuracy across 14,000+ UK retail zones and 200+ external factors.
contribution: Backend API architecture and engineering on the .NET Core platform
Feature configuration and performance optimisation across the platform
Machine learning integration for site revenue prediction

kart.title: KART (Analytical Reporting Tool)
kart.subtitle: Auditing platform
kart.text: Built for KPMG's audit teams, KART is an internal platform for structuring and reporting analytical audit work through a dedicated microservices architecture, rather than ad-hoc tooling.
kart.detailsText: Led the design and development of a microservices architecture using .NET Core and Angular, backed by SQL Server and deployed on Azure, and established the core development codebase.

approach.heading: Approach
approach.sectionIntro: A short look at how I think about systems, and where my engineering is heading.

principles.title: Clean Architecture
principles.text: Separating domain logic from infrastructure so systems stay testable and changeable.

principles.title: CQRS
principles.text: Splitting reads from writes to keep complex business logic and reporting paths clean.

principles.title: Microservices
principles.text: Decomposing platforms into independently deployable services aligned to business capability.

principles.title: API-First Design
principles.text: Designing contracts first so frontend, partners, and integrations can move in parallel.

principles.title: Event-Driven Systems
principles.text: Decoupling services with events where workflows are asynchronous by nature.

principles.title: Cloud-Native Services
principles.text: Building on managed cloud infrastructure for resilience, scale, and operational simplicity.

principles.title: Data & Analytics Pipelines
principles.text: Moving external and operational data through ETL into models people can act on.

principles.title: AI-Enabled Architecture
principles.text: Extending platforms with LLMs and agentic workflows as another engineered layer, not a bolt-on.

approach.note: My focus is on building production-oriented, AI-enabled applications — not simply experimenting with chatbots.
